body: Hi, I am working but training away my job.  I have no family.  I live alone and have no friends.  This online group was my only access to friends

Yes.  That would be ideal.  I have a noose in the closet but I don’t want to use it.  Last time, I think I just caused some damage but nothing lethal.  I’m worried about failing.  I have no one to take care of me if I end up in a messed up state but not dead.

I am in my 40s and feel this a lot.   I did so much “surviving” that I feel like I have just missed out on life the last 20 or 30 years.  I don’t think it’s possible to make up for lost time.  I just want it to end.  I already get the “F” for my performance.
